column1: # @trace order:1874-bair (spec: openspec/changes/local-image-generation, not yet archived)
# THE I0-I3 IMAGEGEN LADDER. Declarative data: TAB-separated, read like
# images/inference/tiers/tier-table.tsv, no interpreter.
# ORDER MATTERS, and it is the OPPOSITE of tier-table.tsv: rows are SMALLEST
# FIRST. Every host STARTS at the first row (I0) whatever its hardware
# (design.md section 3, operator 2026-10-25). The classifier
# (crates/tillandsias-headless/src/imagegen_tiers.rs) walks down from I0 and
# stops at the first row the host does not meet: that last met row is the
# host's CEILING, the highest tier it may be OFFERED, one rung at a time
# (section 5). No rung is skipped.
# LICENCES: permissive or open only (Apache-2.0, MIT, BSD, CreativeML
# OpenRAIL-M, OpenRAIL++-M). No revenue cap, no non-commercial term. Never
# shippable: SD-Turbo, SDXL-Turbo, SD3.5, FLUX.1-dev, RMBG-1.4/2.0. Every
# row's licence is re-verified on its model card by 1874-h9ns before its
# pinned files land; a row whose licence cannot be confirmed is not shipped.
# I0 fallback if sd.cpp cannot load SDXS: segmind/tiny-sd
# (creativeml-openrail-m), then SD1.5 (creativeml-openrail-m).
# Columns ('-' = this path does not earn the tier):
#   tier            I0..I3
#   min_vram_gb     a usable DISCRETE GPU with at least this much VRAM
#   min_unified_gb  OR a usable UNIFIED-memory GPU with this budget (Apple)
#   min_ram_gb      OR a host with at least this much RAM (CPU path)
#   model           the model (and its text encoder, where separate)
#   licence         licence id, from the permissive list above
#   licence_source  the model card the licence was read from
#   size            default square edge in px for the omitted-size case
#   cpu_size        the same, when the run is on the CPU
#   steps           default steps
# A row with all three floors '-' is the floor every host meets (I0 only).
# Byte sizes do not live here; the download manifest (1874-h9ns) carries them.
#tier
I0
I1
I2
I3
